# Claude Business God Mode

> One umbrella that runs a whole business with Claude: CRM, paid ads, SEO and video, sharing one business profile.

## Components
- [Ultimate CRM Template](https://github.com/F0rger123/ultimate-crm-template): leads, quotes, jobs, invoices, payments, portals, SMS, automations
- [Meta Ads God Mode](https://github.com/F0rger123/claude-meta-ads-god-mode): paid media, paused-first, approval-gated
- [SEO God Mode](https://github.com/F0rger123/CLAUDE-SEO-GOD-MODE): rating, audits, local SEO, Search Console, AI search
- [Video Editing God Mode](https://github.com/F0rger123/claude-video-editing-god-mode): editing skills + God Mode Cut approval PWA
